name.name: name
name.repeatable: [Optional, number describes max repeats, -1 for no max]

Splash.name: Splash
Splash.description: The spell splashes into a Cone 2 behind the struck target, dealing Reduced 1 damage to all targets within. If the damaging effect was a Summoned object, it shatters.

Chain.name: Chain
Chain.description: The spell targets another creature within range, repeating for as long as it doesn't target the same character twice.

Invigorate.name: Invigorate
Invigorate.description: Allies hit by the spell ignore its original effect and instead gain +2 Speed until the end of the Round

Duplicate.name: Duplicate
Duplicate.description: You may choose an additional target for the Spell. You must pay for and apply Spell Enhancements seperately for this instance of the Spell.

Distant Spell.name: Distant Spell
Distant Spell.description: The spell's origin can be within 5 Spaces

Sustain.name: Sustain
Sustain.description: The spell's duration increases by 1 tier.
